S V COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING: TIRUPATI 
         INTERNATIONAL WOMEN’S DAY CELEBRATIONS- 08-03-2021 
                                                            Consolidated Report 
As per the instruction of Government of India, Ministry of youth affairs and sports, Regional 
directorate of NSS, On the occasion of International Women’s day, NSS Unit of S V College 
of Engineering has conducted the following events for the women students and faculty on 8th 
March, 2021. 
 EVENTS CONDUCTED: 
1. Musical Chairs 
2. Eating Race 
3. Poster presentation 
4. Tug-of-war 
5. Essay writing 
6. Elocution 
7. Rangoli 
8. Ball passing 
9. Lemon and Spoon. 
 
The programme started at 10 am by lightening the lamp by the chief guest Mrs.Sulochana 
garu, Amara raja battery manufacturing dean. Later the Principal of S V College of 
Engineering, Dr. N. Sudhakar Reddy briefed the objectives and also steps to be taken to 
identify the strengths and abilities to move towards a world of women empowerment. Head 
of the department’s, faculty members, NSS unit and students were actively participated. After 
completion of the events in valedictory session Principal Dr. N. Sudhakar Reddy distribute 
the prizes to the winners. The snapshots of photos are displayed below.

SV COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING: TIRUPATI 
 
 
INTERNATIONAL DAY OF YOGA, June 21, 2020 
 
                                             Consolidated Report 
 
  As per the guidelines received from Directorate of NSS regarding the celebration 
of IDY– 2020. NSS Unit of S.V. COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING has conducted an online 
webinar on the occasion of 6TH INTERNATIONAL DAY OF YOGA with the theme of 
“Yoga@home and Yoga with family” on 21-06-2020. Retired Head Master, Education 
Department, Government of India and also Yoga Practitioner Mr. H.M. Thippeswamy were 
invited as a Chief Guest for the program. The Session started with the prayer song and tribute to 
Maharishi Patanjali, father of Yoga. The Chief Guest of the program, Yoga practitioner 
conducted a demonstration session on various modules which can be helpful to survive without 
any sufferings. Teaching and non teaching staff was actively participated in the session held 
through Google meet and practiced yoga of their own.

SV COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING: TIRUPATI 
 
AWARENESS PROGRAM ON CANCER: 13-03- 2021 
                                                       
                                                       
Consolidated Report 
 
  Awareness Program on “ Breast, Cervical Cancer”  was organized by NSS Unit 
of S V College of Engineering in association with Sri Venkateswara Institute of Cancer & 
Advanced Research (Tata Trusts Hospital), Tirupati on 13 th March 2021 at the College 
Auditorium. 
Dr.P. Nageswara Reddy, Medical Oncologist, SVICCAR, Tirupati was invited as a chief guest. 
He gives awareness a lot regarding identification, screening, diagnosis of breast and cervical 
cancer. Dr N Sudhakar Reddy, Principal, S V College of Engineering in his speech said that 
however, detecting the presence of cancer on time plays a vital role in survival chances. “Early 
diagnosis always helps. People should be aware of the disease and its symptoms. When people 
are aware of the disease and diagnose it on time, better treatment can be provided and it gives a 
better result.
